title: Get the reference
description: Returns the product's `Reference` from `buildReference(repoRoot)`: the schema with the product's own kinds, and Lathe's checks with the product's own. Served by `lathe serve`, the desktop app and the app's Vite plugin alike; it answers JSON (the Reference shape, or an error), and any method but GET with 405.

title: Write to the data
description: Takes `{ commands }`, one write, and applies it through the store's command layer as one transaction. Answers 200 with the changed rows, or 422 with the store's refusal and every reason; the data files change only on 200. It answers JSON (the Write answer shape, or the refusal), and any other method with 405.

title: Get a record's history
description: `GET /api/history?id=<record ID>` (and `&skip=<n>` for older commits) answers with the commits that changed the record's rows in the data files, newest first, and the changes not committed yet. `lathe serve`, the app's Vite plugin and the desktop app (through `serve()`) all serve it. It answers JSON (the History and Change shapes, or `{ "error": "<sentence>" }`), and any method but GET with 405.

title: Get the workspace's data
description: Returns the workspace's `SpecData`: the schema description, each product folder's rows as its data files hold them, and the checks' problems and coverage. One call returns everything; the client builds its index and does all navigation. When the fixture is served, the response carries `x-lathe-source: fixture`. It answers JSON (the Spec data shape, or an error), and any other method with 405.

title: Hear data changes
description: A server-sent event stream that `lathe serve` keeps open: it starts with a `: connected` comment, then sends `data: spec:changed` whenever the product's data files or Lathe's own checks or schema change. The dev server sends the same event through Vite's hot-reload channel instead.
